paragraphs.en: The most powerful and modular AI engine for content creation.

paragraphs.en: ComfyUI is the AI creation engine for visual professionals who demand control over every model, every parameter, and every output. Its powerful and modular node graph interface empowers creatives to generate images, videos, 3D models, audio, and more...
paragraphs.zh: ComfyUI 是面向追求对每个模型、每个参数和每个输出都拥有完全控制权的视觉专业人士的 AI 创作引擎。 其强大且模块化的节点图界面助力创作者生成图像、视频、3D 模型、音频等内容……

paragraphs.en: Simply download, extract with 7-Zip or with the windows explorer on recent windows versions and run. paragraphs.en: torch 2.7 is minimally supported but using a newer version is extremely recommended. Using a cu130 or above version of pytorch is required on Nvidia 20 series and above. Some features and optimizations might only work on newer versions. We generally recommend using the latest major version of pytorch with the latest cuda version unless it is less than 2 weeks old. If your pytorch is more than 6 months old, please update it.
paragraphs.zh: torch 2.7 是最低支持版本，但强烈建议使用更新的版本。 在 Nvidia 20 系列及以上显卡上，需要使用 cu130 或更高版本的 pytorch。 某些功能和优化可能只能在新版本上生效。 我们通常建议使用最新主版本的 pytorch 搭配最新的 cuda 版本，除非该版本发布还不到两周。 如果你的 pytorch 已经超过 6 个月，请更新它。

paragraphs.en: ComfyUI-Manager is an extension that allows you to easily install, update, and manage custom nodes for ComfyUI.
paragraphs.zh: ComfyUI-Manager 是一个扩展，可让你轻松安装、更新和管理 ComfyUI 的自定义节点。

paragraphs.en: pip install -r manager_requirements.txt Enable the manager with the --enable-manager flag when running ComfyUI:
paragraphs.zh: pip install -r manager_requirements.txt 在运行 ComfyUI 时通过 --enable-manager 参数启用管理器：

paragraphs.en: python main.py --enable-manager Command Line Options Flag Description --enable-manager Enable ComfyUI-Manager --enable-manager-legacy-ui Use the legacy manager UI instead of the new UI (implies --enable-manager ) --disable-manager-ui Disable the manager UI and endpoints while keeping background features like security checks and scheduled installation completion (requires --enable-manager ) Running python main.py
paragraphs.zh: python main.py --enable-manager 命令行选项 标志 描述 --enable-manager 启用 ComfyUI-Manager --enable-manager-legacy-ui 使用旧版管理器 UI 而不是新版 UI（隐含 --enable-manager ） --disable-manager-ui 禁用管理器 UI 和端点，同时保留后台功能，例如安全检查和计划安装的完成（需要 --enable-manager ） 运行 python main.py

paragraphs.en: Try running it with this command if you have issues:
paragraphs.zh: 如果遇到问题，请尝试使用以下命令运行：

paragraphs.en: For 6700, 6600 and maybe other RDNA2 or older: HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=10.3.0 python main.py
paragraphs.zh: 对于 6700、6600 或许还有其他 RDNA2 或更旧的显卡：HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=10.3.0 python main.py

paragraphs.en: For AMD 7600 and maybe other RDNA3 cards: HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0 python main.py
paragraphs.zh: 适用于 AMD 7600 以及可能其他 RDNA3 显卡：HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0 python main.py

paragraphs.en: You can try setting this env variable PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=1 which might speed things up at the cost of a very slow initial run.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以尝试设置环境变量 PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=1，这可能会加快运行速度，但代价是初始运行会非常缓慢。

paragraphs.en: Only parts of the graph that have an output with all the correct inputs will be executed.
paragraphs.zh: 只有拥有全部正确输入的输出结果的图的部分才会被执行。

paragraphs.en: Only parts of the graph that change from each execution to the next will be executed, if you submit the same graph twice only the first will be executed. If you change the last part of the graph only the part you changed and the part that depends on it will be executed.
paragraphs.zh: 只有图中在每次执行之间发生变化的部分才会被执行；如果两次提交相同的图，则只有第一次会被执行。 如果你更改了图的最后一部分，则只有你更改的部分以及依赖于它的部分会被执行。

sents.en: Only parts of the graph that change from each execution to the next will be executed, if you submit the same graph twice only the first will be executed.
sents.zh: 只有图中在每次执行之间发生变化的部分才会被执行；如果两次提交相同的图，则只有第一次会被执行。

sents.en: If you change the last part of the graph only the part you changed and the part that depends on it will be executed.
sents.zh: 如果你更改了图的最后一部分，则只有你更改的部分以及依赖于它的部分会被执行。

paragraphs.en: Dragging a generated png on the webpage or loading one will give you the full workflow including seeds that were used to create it.
paragraphs.zh: 在网页上拖拽一张生成的 png 图片或加载一张，即可获得完整的工作流，包括生成它时所使用的种子（seeds）。

paragraphs.en: You can use () to change emphasis of a word or phrase like: (good code:1.2) or (bad code:0.8). The default emphasis for () is 1.1. To use () characters in your actual prompt escape them like \( or \).
paragraphs.zh: 你可以使用 () 来改变某个词或短语的重点程度，例如：(good code:1.2) 或 (bad code:0.8)。 () 的默认重点值为 1.1。 如果要在实际的提示词中使用 () 字符本身，需要对其进行转义，写成 \( 或 \)。

sents.en: You can use () to change emphasis of a word or phrase like: (good code:1.2) or (bad code:0.8).
sents.zh: 你可以使用 () 来改变某个词或短语的重点程度，例如：(good code:1.2) 或 (bad code:0.8)。

sents.en: The default emphasis for () is 1.1.

sents.en: To use () characters in your actual prompt escape them like \( or \).
sents.zh: 如果要在实际的提示词中使用 () 字符本身，需要对其进行转义，写成 \( 或 \)。

paragraphs.en: You can use {day|night}, for wildcard/dynamic prompts. With this syntax "{wild|card|test}" will be randomly replaced by either "wild", "card" or "test" by the frontend every time you queue the prompt. To use {} characters in your actual prompt escape them like: \{ or \}.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以使用 {day|night} 这样的语法来实现通配符/动态提示词。 使用这种语法时，"{wild|card|test}" 会在你每次排队提示词时由前端随机替换为 "wild"、"card" 或 "test" 之一。 要在实际提示词中使用 {} 字符，请像这样转义：\{ 或 \}。

sents.en: You can use {day|night}, for wildcard/dynamic prompts.
sents.zh: 你可以使用 {day|night} 这样的语法来实现通配符/动态提示词。

sents.en: To use {} characters in your actual prompt escape them like: \{ or \}.
sents.zh: 要在实际提示词中使用 {} 字符，请像这样转义：\{ 或 \}。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic prompts also support C-style comments, like // comment or /* comment */ .
paragraphs.zh: 动态提示词还支持 C 风格的注释，例如 // comment 或 /* comment */。

paragraphs.en: Use --preview-method auto to enable previews.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 --preview-method auto 启用预览。

paragraphs.en: The default installation includes a fast latent preview method that's low-resolution. To enable higher-quality previews with TAESD , download the taesd_decoder.pth, taesdxl_decoder.pth, taesd3_decoder.pth and taef1_decoder.pth and place them in the models/vae_approx folder. Once they're installed, restart ComfyUI and launch it with --preview-method taesd to enable high-quality previews.
paragraphs.zh: 默认安装包含一种低分辨率的快速潜空间预览方法。 若要通过 TAESD 启用更高质量的预览，请下载 taesd_decoder.pth、taesdxl_decoder.pth、taesd3_decoder.pth 和 taef1_decoder.pth，并将它们放入 models/vae_approx 文件夹。 安装完成后，重启 ComfyUI 并使用 --preview-method taesd 启动，即可启用高质量预览。

paragraphs.en: Generate a self-signed certificate (not appropriate for shared/production use) and key by running the command: openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -subj "/C=XX/ST=StateName/L=CityName/O=CompanyName/OU=CompanySectionName/CN=CommonNameOrHostname"
paragraphs.zh: 通过运行以下命令生成自签名证书（不适用于共享/生产环境）和密钥：openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -subj "/C=XX/ST=StateName/L=CityName/O=CompanyName/OU=CompanySectionName/CN=CommonNameOrHostname"

paragraphs.en: Use --tls-keyfile key.pem --tls-certfile cert.pem to enable TLS/SSL, the app will now be accessible with https://... instead of http://... .
paragraphs.zh: 使用 --tls-keyfile key.pem --tls-certfile cert.pem 启用 TLS/SSL，此后应用程序将可通过 https://... 而非 http://... 访问。

paragraphs.en: Note: Windows users can use alexisrolland/docker-openssl or one of the 3rd party binary distributions to run the command example above. If you use a container, note that the volume mount -v can be a relative path so ... -v ".\:/openssl-certs" ... would create the key & cert files in the current directory of your command prompt or powershell terminal.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：Windows 用户可以使用 alexisrolland/docker-openssl 或第三方二进制发行版之一来运行上面的命令示例。 如果你使用容器，请注意卷挂载 -v 可以是相对路径，因此 ... -v ".\:/openssl-certs" ... 会在你的命令提示符或 powershell 终端的当前目录中创建密钥和证书文件。

paragraphs.en: As of August 15, 2024, we have transitioned to a new frontend, which is now hosted in a separate repository: ComfyUI Frontend . The compiled JS files (from TS/Vue) are published to pypi and installed as a dependency in ComfyUI.
paragraphs.zh: 自2024年8月15日起，我们已迁移到新的前端，该前端现托管在一个单独的仓库中：ComfyUI Frontend。 编译后的 JS 文件（来自 TS/Vue）会发布到 pypi，并作为依赖项安装在 ComfyUI 中。

sents.zh: 自2024年8月15日起，我们已迁移到新的前端，该前端现托管在一个单独的仓库中：ComfyUI Frontend。

sents.en: The compiled JS files (from TS/Vue) are published to pypi and installed as a dependency in ComfyUI.
sents.zh: 编译后的 JS 文件（来自 TS/Vue）会发布到 pypi，并作为依赖项安装在 ComfyUI 中。

paragraphs.en: For any bugs, issues, or feature requests related to the frontend, please use the ComfyUI Frontend repository . This will help us manage and address frontend-specific concerns more efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 任何与前端相关的错误、问题或功能请求，请使用 ComfyUI Frontend 仓库。 这将帮助我们更高效地管理和处理前端相关的事务。

paragraphs.en: The new frontend is now the default for ComfyUI. However, please note:
paragraphs.zh: 新的前端现已成为 ComfyUI 的默认设置。但是，请注意：

paragraphs.en: To use the most up-to-date frontend version:
paragraphs.zh: 若要使用最新的前端版本：

paragraphs.en: For the latest daily release, launch ComfyUI with this command line argument:
paragraphs.zh: 针对最新的每日版本，请使用以下命令行参数启动 ComfyUI：

paragraphs.en: --front-end-version Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend@latest For a specific version, replace latest with the desired version number:
paragraphs.zh: --front-end-version Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend@latest 如需使用特定版本，请将 latest 替换为所需的版本号：

paragraphs.en: --front-end-version Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend@1.2.2 This approach allows you to easily switch between the stable fortnightly release and the cutting-edge daily updates, or even specific versions for testing purposes.
paragraphs.zh: --front-end-version Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend@1.2.2 这种方法可以让你轻松地在每两周发布的稳定版本与最新的每日更新之间切换，甚至可以指定特定版本用于测试目的。
